Maya: Quick shoutout to @Arjun for jumping on the failing demo build at 08:10. You turned panic into coffee time. :coffee:
Arjun: no biggie, whole team's solid. shout to @Becca for the test repro steps  saved so much time.
Becca: Glad it helped! Also thanks to @Claude for fetching a spare HDMI cable and calming the meeting. :relieved:
Claude: HDMI heroics are my cardio. Also left a sticky note on the kitchen whiteboard saying 'bring cookies for the next sprint review' :memo:
Maya: Cookies accepted. Can we do a tiny poll: :cookie: = bring cookies, :hot_chocolate: = bring hot choc, :tea: = I bring tea. React below.
Becca: :cookie:
Arjun: :hot_chocolate:
Claude: :tea:
ops-bot: Reminder set: sprint-review-treats poll closes in 48h. Auto-note: no pages. :white_check_mark:
Maya: Thanks everyone. Little moments like this keep the nights sane. :heart:
